title: Sidecar NAME.meta.yaml under tech-spec/contracts or tech-spec/data-models, describing a contract or data-model artifact that lives in the code

artifact_path.description: Repository-relative path of the artifact in the code, never under .constitution/. Exactly one of artifact_path and artifact is set (TS-007).

artifact.description: Legacy: file name of a raw artifact in the same directory as this sidecar. Move the artifact into the code and set artifact_path instead (TS-008).

pinned.description: The artifact crosses epic boundaries inside a wave; its entity and field level is fixed before the wave runs

owner.description: Optional ticket that creates the artifact while it does not exist yet; an open ticket whose scope.in covers artifact_path counts as the creator too

companion.description: Markdown companion documenting purpose, invariants, indexes, migration notes

validate_with.description: Command that validates or compiles the artifact, when tooling exists
